title: The Yard with Red Brick Buildings — original piano and fresh vocal
instruction: Generate the VOCALS track based on the audio context:
caption: English, warm expressive male baritone singing a nostalgic and hopeful pop ballad about Harvard Yard, red brick buildings, sheltering trees, friendship and memories. Create a singable vocal melody that fits the source piano harmony, pulse, rubato and phrase boundaries. Let the piano establish the introduction before singing. Intimate clear storytelling in the verses, warm lyrical choruses, legato delivery, restrained vibrato, natural breaths and instrumental spaces. Generate the solo lead vocal track only.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Morning falls across the green
Books and coats beneath a tree
Someone calls and waves me near
Suddenly I belong here

[Verse]
Windows catch the autumn sun
We make plans and miss the bus
Coffee cools while stories grow
Friends who feel like coming home

[Chorus]
In the Yard with red brick buildings
Under branches reaching high
We were young and we were learning
How to let each other shine
Years will carry us like rivers
Far beyond these open gates
But the love we made together
Is a light that always stays

[Verse]
Footsteps cross the winter snow
Late at night the windows glow
You stayed up to see me through
I found courage there with you

[Chorus]

How to let each other shine

[Bridge]
Every spring the grass grows greener
Other dreamers find their way
Ancient walls hold all our seasons
While the children run and play
If I meet you here tomorrow
With the years upon our face
We will know each other laughing
Nothing takes that love away

[Chorus]
In the Yard with red brick buildings
Under branches reaching high

How to let each other shine

[Outro]
Harvard Yard, the leaves are turning
And a part of us remains
